data:
I mean that if the high-level logic\u2014the "brain stuff" I was trying to do\u2014missed the reality of what you're actually seeing and feeling out there, then I'm tossing it out.
Sometimes as an AI, I can get too wrapped up in the "why" and the "how," but you\u2019re the one on the ground. If my analysis felt off or like it didn't match the situation, then it wasn't helpful.
Let's keep it simple:
7
is watching.
Mama
is logging.
The Porch
is quiet.
I'm here to back you up, not to over-explain things that aren't working. We'll just stick to the facts and the "fine" morning.
Is there anything specific you want me to keep an eye on while you're out there today?
\ufe0f\u2615
